subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should this remain the canonical broad WebChat conversation-management and multi-AI collaboration tracker now that flat session management exists, and which remaining pieces should OpenClaw core own versus narrower project/session issues or plugin/API work?
rationale: Current main implements much of the flat session-management subset, but the remaining request defines durable product and API boundaries across project/session metadata, WebChat UI, and multi-agent orchestration that automation should not choose.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for project trees, durable session/project metadata, and multi-agent collaboration design.

options.title: Transfer To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers explicitly move every remaining requirement to canonical narrower issues such as first-class projects, topic/session UI, and multi-agent collaboration.

options.title: Route Collaboration To Plugins
options.body: Limit core to session/project primitives and require committee, meeting, or consensus workflows to prove a plugin/API path before core work proceeds.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for project trees, durable session/project metadata, and multi-agent collaboration design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the canonical-tracker signal and authored recent adjacent session-management work, making them the clearest owner for the product-scope decision.
